browser:Cache.what: Chromium's HTTP disk cache: copies of web pages, images and scripts downloaded while browsing.
browser:Cache.used_for: Lets pages load faster on the next visit. Rebuilt automatically as you browse.
browser:Cache.risk: None known beyond slower first loads.

browser:Cache2.what: Not a Chromium folder; 'cache2' is Firefox's cache name. In a Chromium profile this matches nothing.

browser:Code Cache.what: V8's on-disk cache of compiled JavaScript and WebAssembly, keyed by script URL.
browser:Code Cache.used_for: Skips re-parsing and re-compiling scripts on repeat visits. Rebuilt after a script is seen again.
browser:Code Cache.risk: None known; sites start a little slower until re-cached.

browser:Crashpad\\pending.what: Crashpad's queue of crash reports not yet uploaded.
browser:Crashpad\\pending.used_for: Crashpad retries uploading them later. After deletion those crashes are never reported.
browser:Crashpad\\pending.risk: Lost diagnostics; unsent reports are gone.

browser:Crashpad\\reports.what: Crash reports (minidumps) written by Crashpad, Chromium's crash reporter.
browser:Crashpad\\reports.used_for: Kept until uploaded (if crash reporting is on) or for local analysis. Nothing else needs them.
browser:Crashpad\\reports.risk: Lost diagnostics for recent browser crashes.

browser:DawnCache.what: Cache of Dawn, Chrome's WebGPU implementation (compiled WebGPU shaders/pipelines).
browser:DawnCache.used_for: Rebuilt automatically when WebGPU content runs again.

browser:Extension Cache.what: Not documented by Google for desktop Chrome (an 'Extension Cache' is a ChromeOS concept). Probably matches nothing on Windows.

browser:GPU Cache.what: Not a real Chromium folder name (the real one is 'GPUCache', no space).
browser:GPU Cache.catalog_concern: CHROMIUM_CACHE_CATEGORIES uses 'GPU Cache' with a space, so EnhancedBrowserScanner never finds the real GPUCache. Rename it to 'GPUCache'.

browser:GPUCache.what: Compiled GPU shader programs for the browser's graphics (per profile).
browser:GPUCache.used_for: Avoids recompiling shaders; rebuilt automatically. First page renders can be slightly slower.

browser:GrShaderCache.what: Skia's cache of compiled GPU shaders (Skia is Chrome's graphics engine), stored under User Data.
browser:GrShaderCache.used_for: Avoids shader recompilation; Chrome recreates it. Known to accumulate huge numbers of tiny files.
browser:GrShaderCache.risk: None known; slightly slower first renders.

browser:GrShaderCache\\GPUCache.what: Older layout of Skia's shader cache (a GPUCache inside GrShaderCache).
browser:GrShaderCache\\GPUCache.catalog_concern: Nested inside browser:GrShaderCache; avoid counting it twice.

browser:Media Cache.what: Old Chromium cache for audio/video media. Modern Chromium no longer creates it; media goes into the normal Cache.

browser:ShaderCache.what: Chromium's shared GPU shader cache under User Data (with a GPUCache subfolder).
browser:ShaderCache.risk: None known; brief extra GPU work after cleaning.

browser:ShaderCache\\GPUCache.what: Older layout of the shared shader cache (a GPUCache inside ShaderCache).
browser:ShaderCache\\GPUCache.catalog_concern: Nested inside browser:ShaderCache; avoid counting it twice.

browser:blob_storage.what: Not documented by Google in detail. On-disk backing files for large 'Blob' objects web pages create (temporary binary data such as file uploads/downloads in progress).
browser:blob_storage.used_for: Used while the pages that created the blobs are open. Blobs are temporary; nothing persistent is kept here.
browser:blob_storage.risk: A download or upload in progress in an open tab could fail.

browser:firefox:cache.what: Firefox's cache folder from versions before 32 (renamed cache2 since).

browser:firefox:cache2.what: Firefox's network (HTTP) cache, in the Local profile folder.
browser:firefox:cache2.used_for: Speeds page loads; rebuilt as you browse.

browser:firefox:crashes\\pending.what: Crash reports (.dmp + .extra) Firefox has not yet sent.
browser:firefox:crashes\\pending.used_for: Firefox offers to submit them later. Deleted reports are never sent.
browser:firefox:crashes\\pending.risk: Lost diagnostics: unsent crash reports are gone.
browser:firefox:crashes\\pending.catalog_concern: Path note: Firefox keeps Crash Reports under %APPDATA%\Mozilla\Firefox\Crash Reports, not inside each profile, so a profile-relative path may match nothing. Mark caution in the UI: it is diagnostic data, not cache.

browser:firefox:crashes\\submitted.what: Small .txt receipts with the crash ID of each crash report Firefox already sent to Mozilla.
browser:firefox:crashes\\submitted.used_for: Used by about:crashes to list your submitted reports. The reports themselves are on Mozilla's servers.
browser:firefox:crashes\\submitted.risk: about:crashes no longer lists past crash IDs.

browser:firefox:minidumps.what: Crash dump files written into the profile when Firefox or a plugin crashes, before they are sent.
browser:firefox:minidumps.used_for: Used to build crash reports. After deletion those crashes cannot be reported.
browser:firefox:minidumps.catalog_concern: Diagnostic data rather than cache; caution is more accurate than safe.

browser:firefox:offlineCache.what: Firefox's store for the old HTML5 AppCache (offline website data), a feature deprecated in Firefox 44 and since removed from browsers.
browser:firefox:offlineCache.used_for: Unused by current Firefox; leftovers only.

browser:firefox:startupCache.what: Firefox's start-up cache of pre-compiled internal code.
browser:firefox:startupCache.used_for: Speeds up start-up; recreated on the next launch (first start is slower). Deleting it is a standard fix after bad updates.

browser:firefox:thumbnails.what: Not documented by Mozilla in detail. Screenshots of sites shown on the New Tab page tiles.
browser:firefox:thumbnails.used_for: Firefox re-captures them as you visit sites.
browser:firefox:thumbnails.risk: Blank New Tab tiles until sites are visited again.
